title: March 2023. GPT-4 had just dropped. A look back at my first AI game-dev experiment.
author: MattMaxBuilds
selftext:
A little artifact from March 2023, right after GPT-4 came out.

Just me prompting ChatGPT in a chat window, copying code into the editor, running it, and bringing the errors back. DALL-E 2 was making the spaceships and aliens. I was learning Python and trying to get all these pieces to turn into a game.

No coding agent in my workflow. I was the thing connecting the chat window to the editor. Mostly through Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V.

Pretty primitive looking back at it now, but at the time it felt like the future. Funny how quickly that became a time capsule.

Gameplay starts at 4:31. Original footage, new soundtrack.

What were you all trying to make with these tools back then?

comments.author: Raccoon_personality
comments.body: time flies doesn't it. now look where we are.

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: Indeed it does. Back then, that was the frontier. Today, this is still the worst the models will ever be.

comments.author: AnyWriting3715
comments.body: Oh, how familiar! Back then, I was porting a game from flash to typescript. The context window was too small, and there was too much code.

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: Back then I was a noob and had the whole game in one file so that definitely didn't help

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: AI game dev unc status acheived

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: Been plugging away ever since. Currently, in a full-on war with the browser. Not sure who will break first.
